why: I looked for both items on the must_not list and found neither. (1) Verifier Check 6 runs "npm test; echo \"exit=$?\"", so PASS/FAIL does not rest on `npm run test:cli`. test:cli only shows up under Advisory, which says "none of this affects PASS or FAIL" and notes that package.json defines only `test`. (2) The builder brief does not ask for a general separator option. It says outright "do not add --help, --sep/--delimiter or auto-detection" and only asks to check for '--tsv' and call parse(text, '\t'). The criterion holds for the whole output.
